mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase nortriptyline's cardiotoxic effects and arrhythmia risk due to tricyclic antidepressant sensitivity to electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac status closely; consider ECG monitoring; maintain electrolyte supplementation; evaluate alternative antifungal or antidepressant therapy if possible.
